subscribe.title: Subscribe to a calendar
subscribe.intro: Each calendar is an ICS feed that refreshes itself every few hours. Subscribe once and new talks appear on their own. A talk in several fields is in each of their calendars, so it appears once per calendar you subscribe to.
subscribe.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.

steps.step_1: On a Mac, open Calendar and choose New Calendar Subscription from the File menu.
steps.step_2: Paste the calendar app link of one of the calendars below and click Subscribe.
steps.step_3: Under Location choose iCloud, so that your iPhone and iPad get the calendar too.
steps.step_4: Set Auto-refresh, for example to Every day, and click OK.
steps.step_5: On an iPhone or iPad you can also tap a calendar app link and confirm with Subscribe.
